$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editor hover help.

connessVersion.description: The Conness GIS release this project was made with, set when it was created. Conness upgrades older projects from it, so leave it as it is.
connessVersion.markdownDescription:
The Conness GIS release this project was made with, set when it was created. Conness upgrades older projects from it, so leave it as it is.

Default: older than 1.0.0

title.description: App name, shown in the top bar.
title.markdownDescription: App name, shown in the top bar.

description.description: One or two sentences about the app. Search engines and link previews show it, and it goes in the build's `llms.txt`.
description.markdownDescription: One or two sentences about the app. Search engines and link previews show it, and it goes in the build's `llms.txt`.

logo.description: Logo path, e.g. `"/logo.svg"` for a file in the project's `public/`. Size it with `ui.topBar.logoSize`.
logo.markdownDescription: Logo path, e.g. `"/logo.svg"` for a file in the project's `public/`. Size it with `ui.topBar.logoSize`.

favicon.description: Browser tab icon path, e.g. `"/favicon.png"` for a file in the project's `public/`.
favicon.markdownDescription:
Browser tab icon path, e.g. `"/favicon.png"` for a file in the project's `public/`.

Default: `"/favicon.svg"`

appId.description: Prefix for every localStorage key the app writes (bookmarks, drawings, measure prefs). Give each app its own when several share one domain.
appId.markdownDescription:
Prefix for every localStorage key the app writes (bookmarks, drawings, measure prefs). Give each app its own when several share one domain.

branding.description: Title, logo, page description and storage id.
branding.markdownDescription:

widgetHeader.description: Widget panel title bar. Title color is `theme.widgetTitleColor`.

sideRailSide.description: Side of the side rail (icon strip and its panel).
sideRailSide.markdownDescription:
Side of the side rail (icon strip and its panel).

topBarPanelSide.markdownDescription:

topBarWidgetsSide.markdownDescription:

showBranding.description: Logo and title in the top bar.
